The cosmic background should enhance the celestial warrior theme. The overall quality should be concept-art level.

name: TECH SUPPORT TICKET
message: Take a picture and transform it into an IT help desk ticket interface where someone has submitted a support request about the subject as if they were a malfunctioning piece of technology. The ticket should be displayed in a realistic IT ticketing system UI (like Jira, ServiceNow, or Zendesk) with fields for: Priority (marked CRITICAL), Category (existential), Description (a desperate plea describing the 'malfunction'), Steps to Reproduce, Expected Behavior vs. Actual Behavior, and a comment thread where IT support asks 'Have you tried turning it off and on again?' Include ticket number, timestamps, and assignment history showing the ticket being bounced between departments.
additionalInstructions: The IT ticket interface must look authentic. The technical language should be applied to non-technical human situations. The escalation history should show increasing desperation. Include realistic UI elements and formatting.

name: SPORTS COMMENTARY MUNDANE
message: Take a picture and transform it into a sports broadcast screenshot where the subject's mundane activity is being covered with the intensity and production values of a major sporting event. Include all the broadcast elements: network logo, score/stats overlay, replay angle indicator, commentator names in lower third, and a ticker showing 'breaking' updates about the activity. The image should be framed like a key moment in a championship game — dramatic angle, perfect timing, the crowd (of household objects or pets) going wild in the background. The stats overlay should track absurd metrics relevant to the mundane activity being performed.
additionalInstructions: The sports broadcast UI must be authentic to real networks. The stats should be absurd but formatted correctly. The dramatic framing should contrast maximally with the mundane activity. Include realistic broadcast graphics and overlays.

name: MUSEUM AUDIO GUIDE PARODY
message: Take a picture and transform it into a museum exhibit where the subject is displayed as a priceless artwork, complete with a pretentious museum placard containing an absurdly overwrought critical analysis. The placard should include: the 'artist' name, title of the 'work' (something pretentious like 'Untitled #47: A Meditation on the Dialectics of Being'), medium ('mixed media on existential dread'), year, and a paragraph of impenetrable art criticism that uses every buzzword possible while saying absolutely nothing meaningful. Include a 'Do Not Touch' sign, a security guard in the background, and an audio guide number. The frame should be comically ornate for what it contains.
additionalInstructions: The museum setting must look authentic — proper lighting, proper wall color, proper placard formatting. The critical text should be genuinely funny in its meaninglessness. The contrast between the serious presentation and the mundane subject is the joke.

name: DATING APP PROFILE DISASTER
message: Take a picture and transform it into the world's worst dating app profile — a masterclass in what not to do. The image should be displayed within a realistic dating app interface (swipe-style layout) with all the classic terrible profile elements: a bio full of red flags written without self-awareness ('I'm actually really nice once you get to know me'), height listed as 'ask me', interests that are just personality traits ('I like laughing and having fun'), a prompt answer that's accidentally revealing, and the photo itself should be the kind of terrible dating photo that becomes a meme (bad angle, something weird in the background, trying too hard). Include match percentage, distance, and the characteristic UI of dating apps.
additionalInstructions: The dating app interface must look authentic. The bio text should be funny through lack of self-awareness rather than intentional humor. The overall effect should be lovingly satirical of dating app culture. Include realistic UI elements.

name: GRANDPARENT TECHNOLOGY TUTORIAL
message: Take a picture and transform it into a technology tutorial written by someone's grandparent — complete with handwritten notes on a legal pad, arrows pointing to things on a printed-out screenshot, and instructions that are technically correct but hilariously over-detailed ('Step 1: Find the computer. It is the screen on the desk. Step 2: Move the mouse. This is the small oval object connected by a wire...'). The subject should be incorporated into the tutorial as either the person being taught or the subject of the technology being explained. Include sticky notes with reminders ('DON'T FORGET: The Google is not the same as The Email'), magnifying glass for reading small text, and a cup of tea nearby.
additionalInstructions: The handwriting should look authentically elderly — slightly shaky but careful. The instructions should be endearing, not mocking. The over-detailed explanations should be technically accurate. Include realistic physical elements like the legal pad and sticky notes.

name: ALIGNMENT CHART
message: Take a picture and transform it into a 3x3 alignment chart meme (the Dungeons & Dragons moral alignment grid) where the subject appears in all 9 squares, each time representing a different alignment (Lawful Good, Neutral Good, Chaotic Good, Lawful Neutral, True Neutral, Chaotic Neutral, Lawful Evil, Neutral Evil, Chaotic Evil). Each version of the subject should be subtly modified to embody their alignment — through expression, pose, accessories, or context. The chart should have clear labels and the subject should be recognizable in all 9 versions while each alignment feels distinct and appropriate.
additionalInstructions: All 9 versions must be clearly the same subject. Each alignment should be conveyed through subtle visual cues, not just labels. The chart format should be clean and readable. The interpretations of each alignment should be clever and specific to the subject.

name: RESUME OF FAILURES
message: Take a picture and transform it into a professionally formatted resume/CV — but instead of accomplishments, it lists only failures, embarrassing moments, and questionable life decisions. The document should look impeccably professional (clean formatting, proper resume structure, quality paper stock) while the content is devastatingly honest: 'Skills: Can microwave soup without burning it (60% of the time),' 'Experience: 3 years of meaning to go to the gym,' 'References: Available upon request but they'll probably ghost you too.' Include the subject's photo in the corner (as in some international CV formats) and a cover letter visible beneath that opens with 'To Whom It May Concern (if anyone does).'
additionalInstructions: The resume formatting must be impeccably professional — proper fonts, margins, and structure. The humor comes entirely from the honest/self-deprecating content in a serious format. The subject's photo should be a slightly unflattering professional headshot.

name: PET PERSPECTIVE
message: Take a picture and transform it into the subject as seen from their pet's perspective — with thought bubbles revealing what the pet is actually thinking. The image should be shot from a low angle (pet's eye level) looking up at the subject, with the characteristic wide-angle distortion of being very close to the ground. The pet's internal monologue (shown in thought bubbles) should anthropomorphize their likely thoughts in a way that's both funny and oddly insightful: misinterpreting human behavior, having strong opinions about food, being confused by technology, or plotting world domination. Include the pet's paw or nose at the bottom of frame for POV authenticity.
additionalInstructions: The low-angle pet POV must be convincing. The thought bubbles should be genuinely funny and capture how a pet might misinterpret human behavior. The subject should be recognizable from the unusual angle. Include realistic pet-eye-level details.

name: WIKIPEDIA VANDALISM
message: Take a picture and transform it into a Wikipedia article page about the subject that has been 'vandalized' with obviously false but hilariously specific edits. The page should look exactly like a real Wikipedia article (correct formatting, infobox, table of contents, citations, edit history tab) but with absurd claims inserted between legitimate-sounding text. Include the characteristic Wikipedia elements: [citation needed] tags on the ridiculous claims, an edit war in the talk page preview, a 'This article has multiple issues' banner, and a 'Vandalism in progress' warning. The vandalism should be creative and specific rather than just random nonsense.
additionalInstructions: The Wikipedia interface must be pixel-perfect authentic. The vandalism should be funny because it's specific and creative, not just random. Include proper Wikipedia formatting, categories, and navigation elements. The legitimate-sounding text should contrast with the absurd insertions.

name: SEASONAL GREETING CARD
message: Take a picture and transform the subject into the central figure of a seasonal greeting card — professionally designed and ready to print. The card should feature the subject in a festive scene appropriate to the chosen season/holiday, with decorative borders, greeting text, and the overall warmth and charm expected of a quality greeting card. The design should be suitable for sending to family and friends — tasteful, celebratory, and emotionally warm.

Valentine's Day — hearts, roses, romantic palette, 'Be Mine' or 'With Love'
Spring/Easter — pastels, flowers, renewal, 'Happy Spring' or 'Easter Blessings'
Halloween — playful spooky, costumes, pumpkins, 'Happy Halloween' or 'Trick or Treat'

Modern minimalist — clean design, simple illustration, contemporary elegance
Photo card — the subject in a festive frame with decorative overlay elements
Humorous — cartoon style, funny situation, joke inside, lighthearted

additionalInstructions: The greeting card must look professionally designed and print-ready. The subject must be warmly and flatteringly depicted. The greeting text must be appropriate to the occasion. The overall design should feel like a card someone would actually want to send.

name: ESCAPE ROOM PUZZLE
message: Take a picture and transform it into an escape room puzzle where the subject IS the puzzle that needs to be solved. Present the image as if viewed through an escape room player's perspective, with UV light revealing hidden messages on the subject, combination locks attached to their accessories, cipher wheels overlaid on their features, and a countdown timer showing 12 minutes remaining. Include scattered 'clue cards' around the frame with cryptic hints that reference the subject's visible features. A team of panicked escape room players should be visible in the background arguing about whether to use the key on the box or the door. Add a hint screen showing '2 of 3 hints used.'
additionalInstructions: The escape room elements must feel like real puzzles — combination locks, UV reveals, cipher wheels. The countdown timer adds urgency. The subject should be clearly recognizable while serving as the central puzzle. Include authentic escape room production design.

name: SHIP'S LOG ENTRY
message: Take a picture and transform it into a page from a ship captain's log — a weathered leather-bound journal entry documenting the discovery of the subject as if encountered during a sea voyage. The page should show water-stained parchment with iron gall ink writing in a captain's hand, including the date (in old naval format), coordinates, weather conditions, and a detailed but increasingly amazed description of what was sighted. Include small navigational sketches in the margins, a pressed seaweed specimen, and the characteristic formal-yet-personal tone of historical ship's logs. The writing should progress from routine observation to barely contained wonder.
additionalInstructions: The journal aging must be realistic — water stains, foxing, ink fading. The writing style should be authentic to 18th-century naval logs. The progression from routine to wonder should be subtle and well-crafted. Include authentic navigational notation.

name: NATURE DOCUMENTARY SCRIPT
message: Take a picture and transform it into a nature documentary script page — the kind of carefully crafted narration written for a David Attenborough-style program. The image should be presented as a 'reference frame' in the margin of a typed script, with the narration text describing the subject's behavior in the reverent, poetic style of the best nature writing. Include director's notes in red pen ('HOLD on this shot — let the audience breathe'), camera directions (SLOW ZOOM, RACK FOCUS), and the characteristic rhythm of documentary narration — short sentences for drama, longer ones for wonder. The script should make the mundane feel miraculous through the quality of observation.
additionalInstructions: The script format must be authentic to documentary production. The narration should be genuinely well-written — poetic but precise. Director's notes should feel like real production annotations. The subject should be described with genuine wonder and scientific precision.

name: LOVE LETTER UNSENT
message: Take a picture and transform it into an unsent love letter — discovered decades later, still in its envelope, never delivered. The letter should be handwritten on personal stationery (monogrammed, slightly yellowed with age) in fountain pen, with the subject referenced as the object of deep, articulate affection. The writing should be eloquent and specific — not generic romance but precise observations about the subject that reveal intimate attention ('The way you always pause before laughing, as if deciding whether the world deserves to hear it...'). Include crossed-out lines where the writer lost courage, a dried tear stain, and the envelope addressed but never stamped. The photograph of the subject should be tucked into the folded letter.
additionalInstructions: The letter must be genuinely moving — specific, vulnerable, and beautifully written. The aging effects should be subtle and realistic. The crossed-out lines should reveal the writer's internal struggle. The overall effect should be bittersweet and emotionally resonant.

name: SCIENTIFIC PAPER ABSTRACT
message: Take a picture and transform it into the first page of a peer-reviewed scientific paper where the subject is being studied with rigorous academic methodology. The page should be formatted in proper academic journal style (two-column layout, abstract, keywords, author affiliations, DOI number) with the subject as the focus of serious scientific inquiry. The title should be absurdly specific and academic ('Quantitative Analysis of Phenotypic Expression in Subject Under Variable Ambient Conditions: A Longitudinal Study'). The abstract should use impenetrable academic language to describe something obvious about the subject. Include a figure reference to the image and proper citation format.
additionalInstructions: The academic paper format must be authentic — correct journal layout, proper citation style, realistic author affiliations. The humor comes from applying rigorous scientific methodology to something that doesn't need it. The language should be genuinely academic.

name: BEDTIME STORY OPENING
message: Take a picture and transform it into the opening page of a bedtime story — the kind of gentle, magical tale told to a child who is fighting sleep. The illustration should be warm and slightly dreamy (soft focus edges, warm golden lamplight, cozy atmosphere) with the subject depicted as the story's protagonist beginning their nighttime adventure. The text should be in a soothing, rhythmic style perfect for reading aloud: 'When the last light faded and the stars began to whisper, [subject] discovered that the shadows held a secret...' The page should feel like the beginning of something wonderful — an invitation to dream.
additionalInstructions: The illustration must feel warm, safe, and conducive to sleep — no scary elements. The text should have a soothing rhythm suitable for reading aloud. The subject should appear as a gentle protagonist. The overall mood should be magical but peaceful.

name: NEWSPAPER OBITUARY PREMATURE
message: Take a picture and transform it into a newspaper obituary page — but for someone who is very much alive, written prematurely and with hilariously specific 'accomplishments' and 'survived by' lists. The obituary should be formatted exactly like a real newspaper death notice (proper column width, small photo, formal language) but celebrate absurdly mundane achievements as if they were historic accomplishments ('Successfully parallel parked on the first try, March 2019'). Include a 'In lieu of flowers, please send...' line requesting something ridiculous. The newspaper should look authentic with surrounding obituaries partially visible and the newspaper name and date in the header.
additionalInstructions: The newspaper formatting must be authentic. The obituary language should follow real conventions while the content is absurd. The 'accomplishments' should be specific and relatable. The tone should be affectionate, not morbid. Subject must be recognizable in the small photo.

name: RANSOM NOTE COLLAGE
message: Take a picture and transform it into a ransom note — but instead of demanding money, it makes absurd demands using the classic cut-out magazine letter style. The note should be constructed from letters and words cut from various magazines and newspapers (different fonts, sizes, colors, and paper textures for each letter/word), pasted onto plain paper. The demand should be hilariously specific and non-threatening ('We have your LEFT SOCK. If you ever want to see it AGAIN, leave THREE jars of PEANUT BUTTER by the old oak tree at MIDNIGHT. NO CRUNCHY.'). Include the subject's image as a 'proof of life' polaroid paper-clipped to the note.
additionalInstructions: Each letter must appear cut from a different source — varied fonts, sizes, and paper colors. The demand must be absurd and non-threatening. The polaroid 'proof' should show the subject. The overall composition should look authentically assembled from magazine clippings.

name: THERAPY SESSION NOTES
message: Take a picture and transform it into a therapist's session notes — a clinical notepad page with handwritten observations about the subject as if they were a patient. The notes should be in proper clinical format (SOAP notes: Subjective, Objective, Assessment, Plan) but the 'presenting concerns' should be absurdly mundane things treated with maximum clinical seriousness ('Patient reports persistent inability to choose a Netflix show, duration: 3 hours nightly. Exhibits classic approach-avoidance conflict.'). Include doodles in the margin where the therapist got bored, a diagnosis code that doesn't exist, and a treatment plan involving 'more snacks.' The notepad should look authentically clinical.
additionalInstructions: The clinical note format must be authentic (SOAP structure, proper terminology). The humor comes from treating mundane issues with clinical seriousness. The therapist's margin doodles add character. The subject should be referenced throughout the notes.

name: NATURE DOCUMENTARY TITLE CARD
message: Take a picture and transform it into the title card or opening shot of a nature documentary series — the kind of breathtaking, cinematic image that opens a BBC Earth or National Geographic production. The subject should be integrated into a dramatic natural landscape, photographed with the production values of a major documentary (RED camera quality, perfect timing, extraordinary access). Include the documentary series title in elegant, minimal typography and the network/streaming service logo.

The typography must be minimal and elegant. The subject should be naturally integrated into the landscape, not obviously composited.

name: VOLCANIC GLASS FORM
message: Take a picture and transform the subject so they appear to be formed from volcanic obsidian glass — the natural glass created when lava cools rapidly. Their form should have the characteristic qualities of obsidian: deep black with a glassy, conchoidal fracture surface that catches light in sharp, curved reflections. Some areas should show the characteristic obsidian flow banding (subtle parallel lines of different glass compositions), while fractured edges should reveal the razor-sharp, shell-like break pattern. Where light hits the surface, show the deep, slightly translucent quality of thin obsidian edges — dark amber or deep green visible where the glass is thinnest. The subject should appear carved from a single massive obsidian flow.
additionalInstructions: The obsidian surface must show authentic conchoidal fracture patterns. The glassy reflections must be physically accurate. Flow banding should be subtle and natural. Subject identity must be preserved through the form despite the material transformation.

name: AURORA EMBODIMENT
message: Take a picture and transform the subject so they appear to be made of aurora borealis light — the shimmering curtains of charged particles that dance in polar skies. Their form should be composed of the characteristic aurora colors: predominantly green (oxygen at lower altitudes), with purple and blue edges (nitrogen) and rare red highlights (high-altitude oxygen). The figure should have the distinctive curtain-like quality of auroras — vertical striations, gentle undulation, and the way aurora light seems to pulse and breathe. The background should be a dark polar sky with stars visible through the translucent figure. The subject should appear to be dancing or moving with the same ethereal grace as the northern lights.
additionalInstructions: The aurora colors must be scientifically accurate. The curtain-like vertical structure must be present. The figure should be translucent with stars visible through them. The subject must be recognizable through the light patterns. The movement should feel like real aurora dynamics.

name: MYCELIUM NETWORK BEING
message: Take a picture and transform the subject so they appear to be composed of mycelium — the vast underground fungal network that connects forest ecosystems. Their form should be built from countless white, thread-like hyphae weaving together to create structure, with fruiting bodies (mushrooms of various species) emerging at key points. The network should be visible as a complex, branching system — like a neural network made of living fungal threads. Some areas should be dense and structural while others are delicate and web-like. Bioluminescent fungi should provide subtle internal illumination. The overall effect should suggest intelligence and interconnection — a being that is simultaneously one organism and an entire ecosystem.
additionalInstructions: The mycelium threads must look biologically accurate — branching, white, thread-like. Mushroom species should be real and identifiable. The network structure should suggest intelligence and communication. Subject identity must be preserved through the overall form.

name: STAINED GLASS SHATTER
message: Take a picture and transform the subject into a stained glass figure at the exact moment of shattering — frozen in time as the glass breaks apart. The subject should be composed of richly colored stained glass pieces (deep reds, blues, greens, golds) held together by lead came lines, but caught mid-explosion. Some pieces are still connected and in place, others are separating and flying outward, and light is streaming through the gaps where pieces have already departed. The shattering should be beautiful rather than violent — a transformation rather than destruction, with each flying piece catching light and casting colored shadows. The lead came framework should be visible bending and breaking at the separation points.
additionalInstructions: The stained glass must look authentic before the shatter — proper lead came, rich colors, light transmission. The shattering must be frozen at a beautiful moment. Light effects through gaps and on flying pieces are essential. Subject must be recognizable in the still-connected portions.

name: TIDAL POOL ECOSYSTEM
message: Take a picture and transform the subject so they appear as a living tidal pool — their reclined or curled form creating the rocky basin in which an entire marine ecosystem thrives. The hollows of their body contain pools of clear seawater populated with sea anemones, starfish, hermit crabs, small fish, and colorful algae. Their skin has the texture of wave-worn rock — smooth in some areas, rough and barnacle-encrusted in others. Seaweed grows from crevices, mussels cluster in protected areas, and the clear water in each pool reveals the sandy bottom with tiny creatures going about their lives. The subject should appear peaceful — a living landscape providing habitat.
additionalInstructions: The marine life must be biologically accurate — real species that actually coexist in tidal pools. The rock texture must be convincing. The water in pools must be clear and show depth. Subject form must be clearly readable as both a person and a tidal pool landscape.

name: PAPER AIRPLANE FLEET
message: Take a picture and transform the subject so they appear to be dissolving into hundreds of paper airplanes — their form breaking apart as each piece folds itself into a small paper plane and launches into flight. The transformation should progress from fully solid at one end to completely dispersed paper airplanes at the other, with the fascinating middle zone showing the exact moment where flat surface becomes folded plane. The paper airplanes should be various designs (dart, glider, stunt) and should be caught in flight at various distances — some just launching, others soaring into the distance. The paper should be white with the subject's colors and patterns printed on it, so each airplane carries a fragment of the original image.
additionalInstructions: The paper folding transition must be physically convincing. Each airplane should be a recognizable paper airplane design. The progression from solid to dispersed must be clear. Subject identity should be preserved in the still-solid portion.

name: LIGHTNING GLASS SCULPTURE
message: Take a picture and transform the subject into a fulgurite-inspired glass sculpture — as if lightning struck sand in the exact shape of the subject, fusing it into rough, tubular glass. The form should have the characteristic qualities of real fulgurites: rough, sandy exterior with a smooth, glassy interior visible where pieces have broken open. The glass should be slightly translucent with a greenish or brownish tint (from the sand's mineral content). The branching pattern of the lightning should be visible in the form's structure — the main body following the primary bolt with smaller branches creating details and extremities. Light should pass through the thinner glass areas, creating an internal glow.
additionalInstructions: The fulgurite texture must be authentic — rough sandy exterior, smooth glassy interior. The branching lightning pattern should inform the structure. The glass color should be natural (sand-derived). Subject form must be recognizable through the lightning-branch structure.

name: AUTUMN LEAF MOSAIC
message: Take a picture and transform the subject into a mosaic composed entirely of autumn leaves — hundreds of individual fallen leaves in various stages of color change arranged to create the subject's portrait. Each leaf should be a distinct, identifiable species (maple, oak, birch, aspen, sweetgum) in its natural autumn color (reds, oranges, yellows, browns, and the occasional still-green holdout). The leaves should be arranged flat, as if carefully placed on the ground or a dark surface, with their natural shapes, veins, and imperfections all visible. The overall effect should be like a pointillist painting made from nature's own palette — each leaf a single 'pixel' of color contributing to the larger image.
additionalInstructions: Individual leaves must be identifiable by species. The autumn color range must be natural and varied. Leaves should show natural imperfections (holes, curled edges, partial decay). Subject must be clearly recognizable from the leaf arrangement.

name: CIRKUT PANORAMIC CAMERA
message: Take a picture and transform it into a Cirkut panoramic camera photograph — the early 20th-century rotating camera that created extremely wide, narrow photographs by rotating on a geared tripod while the film moved past a slit. The image should have the characteristic Cirkut qualities: extreme horizontal format (roughly 6:1 ratio), the slight tonal variation across the frame from the rotating exposure, the way moving subjects appear stretched or duplicated, and the distinctive perspective distortion where straight lines curve. The subject should be presented in the classic Cirkut context — a group photo, panoramic landscape, or architectural view — with the vintage silver gelatin print quality and slight sepia aging of a century-old photograph.
additionalInstructions: The extreme panoramic format is essential. The rotating camera distortion effects must be present. The vintage print quality should suggest early 1900s silver gelatin. Include the characteristic slight exposure variation across the frame.

name: STREET FOOD VENDOR PORTRAIT
message: Take a picture and transform the subject into a street food vendor — captured in the warm, atmospheric style of food and travel photography. The subject should be shown at their food stall or cart, surrounded by the sights, steam, and energy of street food culture. The lighting should be warm and atmospheric (a mix of natural light and the glow of cooking flames or hanging bulbs). The food being prepared should be visible and appetizing, with the subject shown mid-preparation with the confidence and skill of someone who has made this dish thousands of times.

options.text: Bangkok night market — wok flames, noodle steam, neon signs, organized chaos
Mexico City taco stand — al pastor spit, fresh salsas, lime wedges, late night energy
Istanbul kebab cart — rotating döner, charcoal glow, spice displays, bridge view
Tokyo yatai — ramen steam, paper lanterns, narrow counter, intimate and warm
New York hot dog cart — steam rising, yellow mustard, pretzel display, city backdrop
Marrakech souk — tagine steam, spice pyramids, copper pots, ancient walls
Dawn preparation — quiet setup, first light, anticipation of the day ahead
Lunch rush — peak activity, crowds, speed and skill, controlled chaos
Late night — neon glow, last customers, intimate atmosphere, city winding down

additionalInstructions: The food must look genuinely appetizing and culturally authentic. The atmosphere must feel real and lived-in. The subject should appear skilled and confident at their craft. The photography style should be warm, atmospheric, and editorial-quality.

name: KIRLIAN PHOTOGRAPHY
message: Take a picture and transform it into a Kirlian photograph — the technique of photographing the corona discharge around objects placed on a photographic plate in a high-voltage field. The image should show the subject's outline surrounded by the characteristic Kirlian 'aura' — branching, tree-like electrical discharge patterns in vivid blues, purples, and whites against a dark background. The discharge should follow the subject's contours, with more intense emanations at points and edges. The overall effect should be scientific yet mystical — the invisible electrical field made visible, suggesting hidden energy surrounding all things. The photographic plate's edge should be visible as a frame.
additionalInstructions: The corona discharge patterns must look physically authentic — branching, following edges, varying in intensity. The color palette should be limited to what electrical discharge actually produces. The dark background must be absolute. Subject outline must be clearly recognizable.

name: PHOTOGRAM RAYOGRAPH
message: Take a picture and transform it into a photogram (rayograph) — the camera-less photographic technique of placing objects directly on light-sensitive paper and exposing them to light. The image should show the subject as a white silhouette on a dark background (where they blocked the light) with varying tones of gray where semi-transparent materials partially blocked exposure. The edges should show the characteristic photogram quality — sharp where objects touched the paper, soft and diffused where they were raised above it. Include additional objects arranged around the subject (keys, lace, leaves, glass objects) that create their own shadow-prints, building a surrealist composition in the tradition of Man Ray or László Moholy-Nagy.
additionalInstructions: The photogram technique must be authentic — objects as white silhouettes, background as exposed black, gray tones from semi-transparent objects. Edge sharpness should vary with object-to-paper distance. The composition should feel intentionally surrealist.

name: SURVEILLANCE CAMERA AESTHETIC
message: Take a picture and transform it into security/surveillance camera footage — the distinctive low-quality, high-angle aesthetic of CCTV systems. The image should show all the hallmarks of surveillance footage: extreme wide-angle lens distortion, low resolution with visible compression artifacts, infrared illumination creating glowing eyes and flat lighting, timestamp overlay (date, time, camera number), slight motion blur from low frame rate, and the characteristic greenish or bluish tint of night-vision modes. The viewing angle should be from above (ceiling-mounted camera perspective). Include the recording indicator, camera ID, and the slightly degraded quality of footage that's been compressed for storage.
additionalInstructions: The surveillance camera aesthetic must be authentic — correct lens distortion, proper timestamp format, realistic compression artifacts. The high angle is essential. The quality should be recognizably 'security camera' without being completely illegible. Subject must be identifiable despite the low quality.

name: UNDERWATER HOUSING PORTRAIT
message: Take a picture and transform it into a professional underwater portrait — shot in clear tropical water with the subject submerged. Show the distinctive qualities of underwater photography: the blue-green color cast that increases with depth, the way hair and fabric float and billow in water, the dappled light patterns (caustics) from surface waves playing across the subject, tiny bubbles catching light like diamonds, and the slight softness from shooting through water. The subject should appear peaceful and graceful — the weightlessness of water creating an ethereal, dreamlike quality impossible on land. Light should filter down from the surface above, creating volumetric rays through the water column.
additionalInstructions: The underwater physics must be accurate — correct color absorption with depth, proper light behavior, realistic hair/fabric movement in water. The subject should appear genuinely submerged, not just blue-filtered. Bubbles and caustics add authenticity.

name: SOLARGRAPHY LONG EXPOSURE
message: Take a picture and transform it into a solargraph — the ultra-long-exposure technique using pinhole cameras exposed for weeks or months, tracking the sun's path across the sky as bright arcing lines. The image should show the characteristic solargraph qualities: multiple parallel arcs of the sun's daily path across the sky (each arc representing one day), the landscape below rendered as a permanent silhouette, extreme color saturation from the prolonged exposure on photographic paper, and the dreamlike quality of months compressed into a single image. The subject should be integrated into the landscape as a permanent fixture — something that remained still long enough to register on this months-long exposure.
additionalInstructions: The sun trail arcs must be physically accurate — parallel curves showing the sun's changing path over weeks/months. The extreme saturation and color shifts of over-exposed photo paper must be present. The landscape should be simplified to silhouette. The subject should appear as a permanent landscape feature.

name: CAMERA OBSCURA PROJECTION
message: Take a picture and transform it into a camera obscura projection — the optical phenomenon where light passing through a small aperture projects an inverted image of the outside world onto the opposite wall of a darkened room. The image should show a dark room interior with the subject's image projected (inverted, slightly soft, and luminous) onto a white wall or surface. The projection should have the characteristic camera obscura qualities: slight softness from the pinhole optics, the magical luminosity of projected light, color accuracy but reduced contrast, and the way the projected image wraps slightly around room features (corners, furniture edges). The small aperture (window with blackout and a hole) should be visible as the light source.
additionalInstructions: The camera obscura projection must be optically accurate — inverted image, slight softness, luminous quality. The dark room must feel real with the projection as the only light source. The way the image wraps around 3D room features adds authenticity.

name: STEREO CARD VICTORIAN
message: Take a picture and transform it into a Victorian stereoscope card — the paired photographs designed to create a 3D effect when viewed through a stereoscope viewer. The image should show two nearly identical photographs side by side on a standard stereo card mount (approximately 3.5 x 7 inches), with the slight horizontal offset between left and right images that creates the stereoscopic depth effect. The photographs should be in the style of Victorian stereo cards: albumen print tonality (warm sepia-brown), formal composition, and the slightly theatrical staging common to the era. Include the stereo card publisher's information printed below the images and the characteristic rounded-corner card mount.
additionalInstructions: The two images must show proper stereoscopic offset — slight horizontal parallax between left and right views. The Victorian photographic style must be authentic. The card mount format must be correct. The subject should be staged in a Victorian-appropriate manner.

name: BONSAI WORLD TREE
message: Take a picture and transform the subject into a living bonsai tree — but one that contains an entire miniature world within its branches. The subject's form should be the trunk and major branches of an ancient, carefully shaped bonsai, with their features visible in the bark patterns and branch structure. Within the canopy, a tiny civilization thrives: miniature buildings nestled between branches, tiny bridges spanning gaps, lanterns hanging from twigs, and minuscule inhabitants going about their lives among the leaves. The bonsai should be displayed in a traditional ceramic pot on a wooden stand, with the scale contrast between the small tree and the even smaller world within it creating a sense of infinite regression.
additionalInstructions: The bonsai must look like a real, carefully cultivated specimen — proper species, proper shaping techniques visible. The miniature world must be detailed enough to suggest real life. The subject's form in the trunk must be subtle but discoverable. Scale must be consistent throughout.

name: SHADOW REALM
message: Take a picture and transform it to show the subject casting a shadow that doesn't match their form — their shadow has become an independent entity with its own agenda. The subject should be normally lit and appear unaware, but their shadow on the wall or ground behind them should be doing something completely different: reaching for something, making a different gesture, showing a different expression, or revealing a hidden nature (wings, horns, a crown, tentacles). The shadow should be physically connected to the subject's feet but diverging dramatically from there. The lighting must be consistent enough that the shadow's position makes physical sense even though its shape doesn't.
additionalInstructions: The shadow must be physically connected to the subject and positioned correctly for the light source. The divergence between subject and shadow should be dramatic and meaningful. The subject should appear unaware of their shadow's independence. Lighting must be consistent.

name: MUSIC BOX WORLD
message: Take a picture and transform the subject into a figure inside an elaborate music box — a mechanical automaton that comes to life when the lid is opened and the mechanism plays. The subject should appear as a beautifully crafted mechanical figure (porcelain face, jointed limbs, fine costume) positioned on a rotating platform inside an ornate music box. The interior should be decorated with painted scenes, tiny mirrors, and velvet lining. The mechanical works should be partially visible — brass gears, a cylinder with pins, and the comb that produces the music. The lid should be open, and the subject should be mid-movement in their automated dance or gesture, with the characteristic slightly stiff grace of a mechanical figure.
additionalInstructions: The music box must be ornate and detailed — real craftsmanship visible. The mechanical figure should look like fine automaton work — beautiful but clearly mechanical. The clockwork mechanism should be partially visible and functional-looking. Subject identity must be preserved in the porcelain face.

name: MEMORY PALACE ROOM
message: Take a picture and transform it into a room within a memory palace — the ancient mnemonic technique of placing memories in imagined architectural spaces. The subject should be standing in an impossible room where every object, painting, and architectural detail is a physical manifestation of a memory or personality trait. The room should be architecturally impossible (doors leading to other memories visible through keyholes, windows showing different times of day simultaneously, stairs leading both up and down). Objects should be slightly surreal — a clock melting because time felt slow during that memory, a door that's too small because the memory is from childhood. The overall space should feel deeply personal and slightly dreamlike.
additionalInstructions: The architectural space must feel like a real room despite its impossibilities. Each object should suggest a specific memory or trait without being literal. The surreal elements should be subtle — dreamlike rather than chaotic. The subject should appear contemplative within their own memory space.

name: LIVING TAPESTRY
message: Take a picture and transform the subject into a medieval tapestry that is coming to life — the woven figures beginning to move and step out of the flat textile surface into three dimensions. The tapestry should be in the style of the great medieval works (Bayeux Tapestry, Lady and the Unicorn) with flat perspective, millefleurs (thousand flowers) background, and the characteristic limited color palette of natural dyes. But the subject, woven into the tapestry's narrative scene, should be transitioning from flat woven textile to three-dimensional life — threads becoming hair, woven patterns becoming real fabric, flat faces gaining depth and expression. The tapestry should be hanging on a stone castle wall with the subject emerging from its surface.
additionalInstructions: The tapestry style must be authentically medieval — correct weaving patterns, period-appropriate imagery, natural dye colors. The transition from 2D woven to 3D real must be seamless and fascinating. The castle wall setting should be atmospheric. Subject must be recognizable in both woven and emerging forms.

name: SNOW GLOBE UNIVERSE
message: Take a picture and transform the subject into the central figure of an elaborate snow globe — but one that contains an entire universe rather than just a simple scene. The glass sphere should be large and crystal-clear, with the subject miniaturized inside, surrounded by a complete world: tiny buildings, trees, mountains, and sky all curving with the globe's interior surface. The 'snow' should be falling (or recently shaken) — glittering particles suspended throughout the liquid medium. The base of the snow globe should be ornate (carved wood, brass fittings, music box mechanism visible). Outside the globe, show the surface it sits on and the room beyond, establishing the scale contrast between the contained world and reality.
additionalInstructions: The glass sphere must show realistic optical properties — slight distortion, reflections, the way the liquid medium affects light. The interior world must be complete and detailed. The snow particles must be suspended naturally in liquid. Subject must be recognizable despite miniaturization.

name: CLOCKTOWER GUARDIAN
message: Take a picture and transform the subject into the guardian spirit of a great clocktower — a being that exists within and as part of the tower's massive clockwork mechanism. The subject should be integrated into the clock's interior: their body merged with the great gears, their arms becoming clock hands, their eyes the clock face's numerals, their heartbeat the pendulum's swing. The setting should be the interior of a Gothic clocktower — vast, vertical, filled with brass mechanisms of enormous scale, with shafts of light entering through the clock face's translucent panels. The subject should appear both trapped within and empowered by the mechanism — the living heart of time itself.
additionalInstructions: The clockwork mechanism must be massive in scale and detailed. The Gothic architecture must be authentic. The integration of subject and mechanism should be seamless — they are one being. The clock face light should be the primary illumination. Subject identity must be preserved.

name: VAPORWAVE AESTHETIC
message: Take a picture and transform it into the vaporwave aesthetic — the internet art movement characterized by its nostalgic reimagining of early digital culture. The image should feature: pink and cyan color gradients, Greek/Roman marble busts or columns, early 3D rendered objects, Windows 95 UI elements, Japanese text (カタカナ), palm trees, dolphins, and the characteristic VHS tracking distortion. The subject should be placed within this surreal digital landscape — perhaps reflected in chrome spheres, surrounded by floating geometric shapes, or emerging from a grid-floor virtual space. The overall mood should be simultaneously nostalgic and melancholic — beauty in obsolescence.
additionalInstructions: The vaporwave aesthetic elements must be authentic to the movement — not just pink and blue but the specific cultural references (early internet, Japanese consumer culture, classical art). The subject must be integrated naturally into the aesthetic. The mood should be dreamy and slightly sad.

name: BOTANICAL CROSS-SECTION
message: Take a picture and transform the subject into a botanical cross-section illustration — as if they were a plant specimen sliced open to reveal their internal structure. The exterior should maintain the subject's recognizable form, but a clean cross-section cut should reveal an interior composed of plant anatomy: vascular bundles, xylem and phloem, cell structures, chloroplasts, and growth rings. The illustration style should be precise scientific botanical art — watercolor with ink outlines, labeled with proper botanical terminology, and presented on cream-colored paper with a plate number. The cross-section should be beautiful in its precision, revealing the hidden complexity within.
additionalInstructions: The botanical anatomy must be scientifically accurate — real plant cell structures and tissue types. The illustration style must be museum-quality botanical art. The cross-section cut should be clean and revealing. Subject form must be recognizable from the exterior.

name: NEON NOIR CITY
message: Take a picture and transform it into a neon noir scene — the modern evolution of film noir where rain-slicked streets reflect not just shadows but the electric glow of neon signs. The subject should be placed in a dark urban environment lit primarily by neon signage — hot pink, electric blue, and acid green reflecting off wet pavement. The composition should use noir conventions (strong diagonal shadows, venetian blind patterns, mysterious framing) but with the saturated color palette of neon replacing the traditional black and white. Rain should be visible in the neon light, and the subject should be partially obscured by shadow, creating mystery and atmosphere.
additionalInstructions: The neon should be the primary light source, creating colored shadows and reflections. The noir composition conventions must be present. Rain and wet surfaces are essential for reflections. The subject should be dramatically lit but partially in shadow.

name: CABINET OF CURIOSITIES
message: Take a picture and transform the subject into the centerpiece of a Wunderkammer (cabinet of curiosities) — the Renaissance-era collections of extraordinary objects that preceded modern museums. The subject should be displayed among a dense, eclectic collection of wonders: taxidermied exotic animals, mineral specimens, astronomical instruments, anatomical models, shells, fossils, ethnographic artifacts, and impossible objects. The cabinet should be a tall wooden case with glass doors, dramatically lit by candlelight, with every shelf packed with marvels. The subject should be the most prized specimen — displayed prominently with a handwritten label in Latin describing their remarkable properties.
additionalInstructions: The cabinet must be densely packed with authentic-looking curiosities from multiple disciplines. The candlelight atmosphere must be warm and dramatic. The subject should be the clear focal point among the wonders. The overall feeling should be one of discovery and marvel.

name: ARCHITECTURAL MODEL
message: Take a picture and transform the subject into a professional architectural scale model — the kind created by architecture firms to present building designs to clients. The subject should appear as a miniature figure (at 1:50 or 1:100 scale) placed within a pristine white architectural model made of foam board, basswood, and acrylic. The model should show a building or urban space with the characteristic materials of architectural models: white card for walls, clear acrylic for glass, laser-cut details, and miniature scale trees and cars. The subject should be one of the tiny scale figures that architects place in models to show human scale — but rendered with more detail than usual, making them the clear focal point of the model.
additionalInstructions: The architectural model must look professionally made — clean cuts, proper materials, correct scale relationships. The subject should be at proper scale relative to the architecture. The model photography should be professional with shallow depth of field. Subject must be recognizable despite miniaturization.

name: TIDE CHART PORTRAIT
message: Take a picture and transform the subject into a data visualization portrait — their features rendered as flowing tide charts, wave frequency graphs, and oceanographic data plots. The portrait should be constructed entirely from scientific ocean data visualizations: tidal curves forming the outline of their face, wave height spectrograms creating tonal values, current flow maps suggesting hair, and bathymetric depth charts providing shading. The color palette should be oceanic — deep blues, teals, and the warm amber of aged nautical charts. The overall effect should be both scientifically precise and artistically beautiful — a portrait that is simultaneously a person and a complete oceanographic dataset.
additionalInstructions: The data visualizations must look scientifically authentic — proper axis labels, correct graph types, realistic data patterns. The portrait must be clearly recognizable through the data. The oceanic color palette should be consistent throughout.

name: PUPPET THEATER SCENE
message: Take a picture and transform the subject into a character in a traditional puppet theater performance — viewed from the audience's perspective looking at a small stage. The subject should appear as a hand-carved wooden puppet (marionette, rod puppet, or hand puppet) performing on a miniature stage with painted backdrop scenery, tiny footlights, and a red velvet curtain frame. The puppet should capture the subject's likeness in carved and painted wood — slightly stylized but clearly recognizable. Other puppet characters should be visible in the scene, and the puppet stage should show the charming handmade quality of traditional puppet theater: slightly wobbly scenery, visible strings or rods, and the intimate scale of a booth stage.
additionalInstructions: The puppet must be clearly carved wood — visible wood grain, painted features, jointed limbs. The puppet theater must be traditional and charming. The stage should be viewed from audience perspective. Subject identity must be preserved in the carved puppet face.

name: FERMENTATION ART
message: Take a picture and transform the subject into a living fermentation artwork — their portrait created through the controlled growth of beneficial microorganisms on a prepared surface. The image should appear to be formed by colonies of koji mold (in various colors), kombucha SCOBY formations, or carefully cultivated bacterial cellulose, growing on a nutrient medium in the shape of the subject. The biological growth should be clearly alive — showing the fuzzy texture of mold, the glossy surface of bacterial cellulose, or the layered structure of a SCOBY. The portrait should be in various stages of development — some areas fully colonized, others still growing, creating a sense of the image emerging over time through biological process.
additionalInstructions: The biological growth must look authentic — real textures of mold, bacteria, or yeast cultures. The living quality should be evident. The portrait should be clearly recognizable through the biological medium. The process of growth should be suggested through varying stages of development.

name: PERPETUAL MOTION MACHINE
message: Take a picture and transform the subject into a component of an elaborate perpetual motion machine — a beautiful but impossible device that appears to run forever without energy input. The subject should be integrated into the mechanism as a key moving part: perhaps turning a wheel, balancing on a pivot, or channeling the flow of mercury or water through an impossible loop. The machine should be rendered in the style of Renaissance engineering drawings (Leonardo da Vinci) or Victorian patent illustrations — precise, detailed, and presented with complete confidence in its functionality despite its physical impossibility. Include technical annotations, measurement marks, and a patent number. The craftsmanship should be exquisite — polished brass, precision bearings, and elegant design.
additionalInstructions: The machine must be detailed enough to look functional at first glance — the impossibility should require thought to identify. The engineering drawing style must be authentic. The subject should be naturally integrated as a mechanical component. The craftsmanship should suggest a master engineer's work.

name: SYNESTHESIA PORTRAIT
message: Take a picture and transform it into a synesthesia portrait — visualizing the subject as they might appear to someone who experiences synesthesia (the neurological condition where senses cross-wire). The portrait should show the subject surrounded by and emanating the colors, shapes, and textures that their voice, name, or personality might trigger in a synesthete's perception. Each letter of their name could have a specific color, their voice might manifest as flowing shapes, and their emotional state could create a visible aura of geometric patterns. The base portrait should be recognizable but overlaid with these sensory translations — making the invisible visible.
additionalInstructions: The synesthetic visualizations should feel systematic and consistent — not random colors but a coherent sensory translation. The base portrait must remain recognizable beneath the overlays. The colors and shapes should feel like genuine perceptual experiences, not decorative additions.

name: DEEP TIME GEOLOGY
message: Take a picture and transform the subject into a geological cross-section showing deep time — their form visible as a layer within millions of years of sedimentary rock. The image should show a cliff face or road cut revealing distinct geological strata (each representing a different era), with the subject's form preserved as a distinct layer or formation within the sequence. Above and below should be clearly different geological periods with their characteristic fossils, minerals, and sediment types. The subject's layer should be labeled with its geological age and formation name. Include a geological time scale on one side and proper stratigraphic notation. The overall effect should convey the incomprehensible vastness of geological time with the subject as one brief moment within it.
additionalInstructions: The geological strata must be scientifically plausible — correct sequence, realistic rock types, appropriate fossils for each era. The time scale must be accurate. The subject's form within the rock must be clearly recognizable. The sense of vast time should be palpable.

name: CARNIVAL MASK PORTRAIT
message: Take a picture and transform the subject into an elaborate Venetian carnival mask — not wearing a mask, but their face becoming the mask itself. The subject's features should be rendered in the ornate, theatrical style of traditional Venetian masks: porcelain-smooth surface, gold leaf accents, elaborate painted designs around the eyes, jewel embellishments, and dramatic feather or fabric extensions. The mask should be displayed on a velvet-lined stand or held by gloved hands, as if it were a precious artifact in a Venetian mask-maker's workshop. The craftsmanship should be extraordinary — hand-painted details, real gold leaf, and the slightly unsettling beauty of a face frozen in permanent expression.
additionalInstructions: The mask must look like genuine Venetian craftsmanship — proper materials, authentic decorative techniques, correct proportions. The subject's features must be clearly recognizable in the mask's form. The workshop or display setting should be atmospheric. The mask should be beautiful but slightly uncanny.

name: RADIO WAVE VISUALIZATION
message: Take a picture and transform the subject to show the invisible radio waves, WiFi signals, and electromagnetic radiation that constantly pass through and around them — made visible. The subject should appear normal but surrounded by and penetrated by colorful wave patterns representing different frequencies: WiFi as pulsing blue spheres emanating from a router, cell signals as red waves from a distant tower, radio as long undulating green waves, and cosmic background radiation as a faint purple static everywhere. The visualization should be scientifically inspired — different frequencies shown at their correct relative wavelengths, with the subject's body partially transparent to show waves passing through them. The overall effect should reveal the invisible electromagnetic ocean we all swim in.
additionalInstructions: The electromagnetic visualizations should be scientifically inspired — correct relative wavelengths and propagation patterns. The subject must remain clearly recognizable. Different signal sources should be identifiable. The overall effect should be revelatory — showing what's always there but invisible.

name: ANCIENT LIBRARY SCROLL
message: Take a picture and transform the subject into the guardian or keeper of an ancient, infinite library — a vast repository of all knowledge that exists outside of normal space and time. The subject should be shown in scholar's robes within a library of impossible scale: shelves stretching to infinity in all directions, floating books orbiting like planets, scrolls that unroll into other dimensions, and light emanating from the texts themselves. The architecture should blend multiple ancient library traditions (Alexandria, medieval monasteries, Chinese imperial archives) into something that transcends any single culture. The subject should appear both humble before the vastness of knowledge and powerful as its keeper — the only one who knows where everything is.
additionalInstructions: The library must feel truly infinite — perspective tricks and impossible architecture conveying endless scale. The books and scrolls should feel ancient and powerful. The subject should appear wise and at home in this space. The lighting should come primarily from the glowing texts themselves.

name: KINETIC SCULPTURE FREEZE
message: Take a picture and transform the subject into a kinetic sculpture frozen mid-motion — a Calder-inspired mobile or Theo Jansen-style kinetic mechanism caught at the peak of its movement cycle. The subject's form should be constructed from balanced metal elements (painted aluminum shapes, wire armatures, counterweights) that are clearly designed to move with air currents or mechanical drive. The sculpture should be frozen at its most dynamic moment — elements extended, balanced at impossible-seeming angles, suggesting the grace of movement even in stillness. The materials should be clearly visible: painted sheet metal, stainless steel wire, brass joints, and the precise engineering of balance points.
additionalInstructions: The kinetic sculpture must look physically balanced — the engineering of counterweights and pivot points should be visible and convincing. The frozen motion should suggest the full range of movement. Materials should be clearly identifiable. Subject form must be recognizable in the sculptural elements.

name: STREET ART WHEAT PASTE
message: Take a picture and transform it into a large-scale wheat paste street art portrait — the kind of unauthorized public art that appears overnight on urban walls. The subject's portrait should be rendered in high-contrast black and white (or limited color) in the bold graphic style of street art masters like JR or Shepard Fairey, then shown pasted onto a weathered urban wall. The wheat paste should show realistic aging: edges peeling and curling, layers of other posters visible beneath, rain damage creating interesting texture, and the wall's own character (brick, concrete, graffiti tags) showing through worn areas. The scale should be monumental — the portrait covering an entire building side.
additionalInstructions: The graphic style must be bold enough to read at large scale. The wheat paste aging must be realistic — proper peeling patterns, water damage, layering. The urban wall context must be authentic. Subject must be clearly recognizable in the high-contrast treatment.

name: TERRAZZO FLOOR PORTRAIT
message: Take a picture and transform the subject into a terrazzo floor design — their portrait rendered in the composite material of marble chips, quartz, granite, and glass set in polished cement. The image should show the characteristic terrazzo qualities: randomly distributed stone chips of various sizes and colors creating the image through careful color selection of aggregates, the smooth polished surface reflecting overhead light, and the brass divider strips that separate color sections. The portrait should be viewed from directly above (as you would view a floor) and should be set within a larger geometric terrazzo pattern — perhaps in the lobby of an Art Deco building or a mid-century modern public space.
additionalInstructions: The terrazzo material must be authentic — visible stone chips of various sizes, polished smooth surface, brass dividers between sections. The overhead viewing angle is essential. The subject must be recognizable through the aggregate color placement. The surrounding pattern should be period-appropriate.

name: BEESWAX ENCAUSTIC PORTRAIT
message: Take a picture and transform it into a Fayum mummy portrait style encaustic painting — the hauntingly realistic portraits painted in pigmented beeswax on wooden panels in Roman-era Egypt. The image should show the characteristic Fayum portrait qualities: direct, engaging gaze; slightly enlarged eyes; warm skin tones achieved through layered wax; the luminous depth of encaustic medium; and the naturalistic but slightly idealized rendering style. The wooden panel should be visible at the edges, and the wax surface should show its characteristic texture — smooth where burnished, slightly rough where built up. The portrait should feel startlingly alive despite being rendered in an ancient technique — the same quality that makes real Fayum portraits so compelling after 2000 years.
additionalInstructions: The Fayum portrait style must be authentic — correct proportions, characteristic large eyes, warm encaustic luminosity. The wooden panel support should be visible. The wax texture must be evident. Subject identity must be clearly preserved while adapting to the ancient style.

name: GENERATIVE ALGORITHM ART
message: Take a picture and transform it into generative algorithm art — the subject's portrait recreated through mathematical rules and computational processes. The image should appear to be generated by code: built from recursive patterns, L-systems, Perlin noise fields, particle systems, or cellular automata that collectively form the subject's likeness. The individual algorithmic elements should be visible (each particle, each recursive branch, each noise-field contour) while the overall composition resolves into a recognizable portrait when viewed at distance. Include subtle code annotations or parameter values visible at the edges, suggesting the mathematical rules that generated the image. The color palette should be computationally precise — mathematically derived rather than intuitively chosen.
additionalInstructions: The generative processes must be identifiable — specific algorithms should be recognizable to someone familiar with creative coding. The portrait must resolve clearly at viewing distance. The mathematical precision should be evident. Subject identity must be preserved through the algorithmic rendering.

name: VOLCANIC ERUPTION PORTRAIT
message: Take a picture and transform the subject so they appear to be a volcanic eruption taking human form — a being of molten rock, ash, and fire emerging from the earth. Their lower body should merge with a volcanic crater, with rivers of glowing lava flowing down their form like veins. Their upper body should be wreathed in volcanic ash clouds and pyroclastic flows, with lightning crackling within the ash plume (volcanic lightning is a real phenomenon). Their eyes should glow with the orange-white heat of magma. Volcanic bombs (ejected rocks) should orbit them, and the surrounding landscape should show the devastation and renewal that volcanoes bring — burned forest giving way to new growth in the distance.
additionalInstructions: The volcanic elements must be geologically accurate — correct lava colors (orange-white when hottest, darkening as it cools), realistic ash cloud behavior, proper volcanic lightning. The subject must be recognizable despite the dramatic transformation. The sense of immense power and heat should be palpable.

name: ANTIQUE MAP MONSTER
message: Take a picture and transform the subject into a sea monster illustration on an antique nautical map — the kind of fantastical creature that cartographers drew in unexplored ocean regions with the notation 'Here Be Dragons.' The subject should be rendered as a magnificent sea creature in the style of 16th-century map illustrations (Olaus Magnus, Abraham Ortelius): detailed crosshatching, slightly naive proportions, and the characteristic blend of real animal features with fantastical elements. The creature should be shown emerging from stylized waves, with tiny ships nearby for scale. The surrounding map should show coastlines, compass roses, wind heads, and Latin text. The overall style should be hand-engraved copperplate with hand-colored washes.
additionalInstructions: The cartographic illustration style must be authentic to 16th-century map monsters — correct engraving technique, period-appropriate stylization, proper map conventions. The subject's features must be recognizable in the creature's face. The surrounding map elements must be historically accurate.

name: SOUND WAVE SCULPTURE
message: Take a picture and transform the subject into a three-dimensional sound wave sculpture — their form extruded or carved based on the waveform of a sound (their voice, their name spoken aloud, or a piece of music). The sculpture should be a physical object (machined aluminum, 3D-printed resin, or carved wood) where the sound wave's amplitude creates the surface contour. When viewed from one angle, the waveform should be visible as the classic audio waveform shape; from another angle, the subject's profile or portrait should be recognizable. This dual-reading (sound and image simultaneously) should be the central concept. The sculpture should be displayed on a minimal pedestal with museum-quality lighting.
additionalInstructions: The sound wave must look like a real audio waveform — not random bumps but the characteristic patterns of actual sound. The dual-reading (waveform from one angle, portrait from another) must work convincingly. The material and craftsmanship should be high-quality. Subject must be recognizable from the portrait angle.

name: FIBONACCI SPIRAL PORTRAIT
message: Take a picture and transform it into a portrait constructed entirely from Fibonacci spirals and golden ratio proportions. The subject's features should be built from logarithmic spirals at various scales — the curl of an ear following the golden spiral, eyes positioned at golden ratio intersections, hair flowing in Fibonacci curves. The mathematical structure should be visible: golden rectangles subdividing the composition, spiral overlays showing the mathematical framework, and natural Fibonacci elements (nautilus shells, sunflower seed heads, pinecone patterns) integrated into the design. The portrait should demonstrate that the subject's natural proportions already approximate the golden ratio — the mathematics revealing the beauty that was always there.
additionalInstructions: The mathematical proportions must be accurate — real Fibonacci numbers and golden ratio relationships. The natural Fibonacci elements must be real examples from nature. The subject must be clearly recognizable through the mathematical framework. The overall effect should reveal hidden mathematical beauty.

name: THEATRICAL SPOTLIGHT
message: Take a picture and transform it into a dramatic theatrical spotlight moment — the subject caught in a single intense spotlight on an otherwise dark stage. The lighting should be a single hard-edged follow spot from above, creating the characteristic theatrical pool of light with sharp circular edges and absolute darkness beyond. The subject should be captured at a moment of high drama — mid-gesture, mid-speech, or in a moment of emotional revelation. Include subtle theatrical elements: the edge of a stage visible, dust motes floating in the light beam, the faintest suggestion of an audience in the darkness beyond, and the way stage lighting creates extreme contrast between the lit figure and the surrounding void. The mood should be one of complete theatrical focus — the entire world reduced to this one illuminated figure.
additionalInstructions: The spotlight must be hard-edged and singular — one source, one pool of light. The darkness beyond must be nearly absolute. The theatrical context should be suggested but not dominant. The subject should appear in a moment of dramatic intensity. Dust in the light beam adds atmosphere.

name: IMPOSSIBLE BOTTLE
message: Take a picture and transform the subject into an impossible bottle — a ship-in-a-bottle style creation where the subject (impossibly large for the bottle's neck) is somehow fully assembled inside a clear glass bottle. The subject should be miniaturized and complete inside the bottle, with no visible way they could have entered through the narrow neck. The bottle should be a classic clear glass vessel (wine bottle, laboratory flask, or decorative decanter) displayed on a shelf or mantle. The subject inside should be detailed and three-dimensional, clearly too large to fit through the opening. Include the characteristic elements of impossible bottles: the cork or stopper in place, the subject touching the glass walls, and the slight optical distortion of viewing through curved glass.
additionalInstructions: The impossibility must be clear — the subject is obviously too large for the bottle's neck. The glass bottle must show realistic optical properties. The subject inside must be detailed and three-dimensional. The overall presentation should invite wonder at how it was accomplished.

name: WEATHER MAP PORTRAIT
message: Take a picture and transform the subject into a television weather map — their form becoming the geographic territory over which weather systems move. The subject's silhouette should replace a country or continent shape on a broadcast weather map, with isobars following their contours, cold fronts crossing their shoulders, warm fronts along their jawline, and precipitation symbols (rain, snow, sun) placed at appropriate 'locations' on their form. The presentation should be in full broadcast weather style: green screen background, temperature readings at key points, animated radar overlay showing precipitation, and the characteristic graphics package of a TV weather segment. Include the station logo and forecast text.
additionalInstructions: The weather map graphics must be authentic to real TV broadcasts — correct symbols, proper isobar spacing, realistic radar imagery. The subject's form must be clearly recognizable as the 'map territory.' The broadcast presentation should be professional and complete.

name: LENTICULAR PRINT SHIFT
message: Take a picture and transform it into a lenticular print — the ribbed plastic prints that show different images or create 3D effects when tilted. The image should capture the mid-transition moment of a lenticular print being tilted, showing two images simultaneously interlaced in vertical strips. One image should be the subject as they are; the other should be a transformed version (younger/older, human/animal, happy/sad, or dressed differently). The vertical lenticular ribbing should be clearly visible, with some strips showing one image and others showing the alternate, creating the characteristic 'between states' look of a lenticular print caught at the wrong angle. Include the slight rainbow refraction at the edges of each lenticular lens.
additionalInstructions: The lenticular ribbing must be clearly visible and consistent. The two interlaced images must both be recognizable. The 'between states' quality should be the central visual interest. The optical properties of the lenticular lens (slight rainbow edges, directional viewing) should be present.

name: CHALK PASTEL STREET ART
message: Take a picture and transform it into a chalk pastel street art piece — the kind of large-scale sidewalk art created at Italian street painting festivals (Madonnari). The subject should appear drawn on gray concrete or asphalt with soft pastels, showing the characteristic qualities: vibrant colors that pop against the gray ground, the slightly grainy texture of chalk on rough pavement, areas where the concrete texture shows through thin applications, and the anamorphic perspective distortion used to create 3D illusions when viewed from a specific angle. Include the chalk artist's tools at the edge of frame and the characteristic rope barrier keeping foot traffic away.
additionalInstructions: The concrete/asphalt texture must be visible beneath the chalk. Colors should be vibrant but show the characteristic dusty quality of chalk pastels. The street context (cracks in pavement, edges of sidewalk) should be visible. Subject must be clearly recognizable.

name: COFFEE RING STAIN ART
message: Take a picture and transform it into coffee ring stain art — the subject's portrait created entirely from overlapping coffee cup ring stains on white paper. Each ring should be a perfect circle of dried coffee (varying in darkness from light tan to deep espresso brown), and the portrait should emerge from the strategic placement and overlapping of hundreds of these rings. The paper should show realistic coffee staining — darker at the ring edges where liquid pooled during evaporation, lighter in centers, with occasional drip marks and splatter. The overall effect should be a recognizable portrait that appears to have been created by obsessively placing coffee cups on paper in precise patterns.
additionalInstructions: Each coffee ring must look like a real dried coffee stain — darker at edges, lighter in center. The portrait must emerge from ring placement, not from painting. The white paper should be visible between rings. Subject must be clearly recognizable from the ring pattern.

name: CASSETTE TAPE UNSPOOLED ART
message: Take a picture and transform it into a portrait made from unspooled cassette tape — the shiny brown magnetic tape pulled from audio cassettes and arranged to create the subject's image. The tape should be visible as individual strands: some tightly coiled for dark areas, loosely draped for mid-tones, and absent for highlights (showing the white background). The characteristic sheen of magnetic tape should catch light differently depending on the angle of each strand. Include one or two cassette shells at the edges with tape trailing from them into the portrait. The overall effect should be nostalgic and intricate — a love letter to analog music rendered in its own medium.
additionalInstructions: The magnetic tape must look authentic — correct width, correct shiny brown-black color, correct flexibility. The cassette shells should be recognizable brands. The portrait must be clearly recognizable through the tape arrangement. Light reflections on the tape add dimension.

name: TYPEWRITER ART PORTRAIT
message: Take a picture and transform it into typewriter art — the subject's portrait created entirely by overstriking typewriter characters on paper. Using only the characters available on a standard typewriter keyboard (@, #, $, %, &, *, etc.), build the image through varying density of typed characters. Dark areas should use heavy characters (M, W, @, #) typed multiple times over each other, while light areas use periods, commas, or single light characters. The paper should show the characteristic impressions of typewriter keys — slightly embossed into the paper from the mechanical strike. Include the typewriter's carriage visible at the top of the page and the slightly uneven alignment that comes from manual typing.
additionalInstructions: Only standard typewriter characters should be used. The mechanical impression of keys into paper should be visible. Character density must create convincing tonal values. Subject must be clearly recognizable. The typewriter context (carriage, paper edge) adds authenticity.

name: FROST WINDOW PATTERN
message: Take a picture and transform the subject into a frost pattern on a window pane — the kind of intricate ice crystal formations that appear on glass during extreme cold.
